title: 第十八章 大比二第十九章 大比三
content_zh:
得到师傅肯定答应之后，秦凤鸣之后的习武更是刻苦，早出晚归，风雨无阻，从未有所间断。
张堂主回来后，并未见到袁克俭，自是大为不解，虽询问了一番其他弟子，但也并未太过深究此事，因为再一次落霞谷选拨新弟子之事，此时也正在如火如荼进行。
此时对此一两名新近弟子失踪之事，他自是无暇分身。
日月穿梭，花开花落，日子不觉间又过去了数月。
距百炼堂比武之日越来越近，在此期间，与秦凤鸣同入门的其他弟子，也已自教习口中知晓了比武之事，众人兴奋之余，却是被告知，今年比武，他们不得参加，只是到时可以前去观看，这让众弟子感到气馁以极。
但想想之后，众人也自释然，满打满算，他们进入落霞谷不过三年，习武更是仅有两年时间，比起那些已入门六七年的弟子，之间差距，可想而知。
此次大比，往届所有依旧在百炼堂修炼弟子都会参加，总人数有六七十人之多，入门最少之人，也已有五六年之久，其中更是十数名，已然入门**年之人。
好在此种大比，仅限于百炼堂，如果加上那些落霞谷门人弟子的子弟，同龄之人将会达到上百人之多。
欲要在如此多好手参与的比试之中取得好成绩，其难度之大，可想而知。
对于比试成绩，虽然秦凤鸣并未放在心上，但争强好胜之心，年少的他自是会存有。
故此，除了每日习武，其他之事，秦凤鸣不再理会分毫。
随着日子一天天过去，终于，大比之日终是是来临了。
这一日清晨，一身穿青衫的青年将秦凤鸣等同来弟子带到了一处山谷。
此山谷广大非常，在山谷之中，有十座两三丈高石台存在，每一高台方圆足有二十数丈宽窄。
中间一高台，却足有五六丈之高。
在此高台之上俯视四周，周围高台却是历历在目。
此时，山谷之中已有许多弟子存在，东一波，西一波相互聚拢一起。
四周都是身穿青衫和棕色长衫的青年，这些人，秦凤鸣都未曾见过，并非是百炼堂弟子。
看着山谷中间聚在一起，身穿灰衫的弟子，秦凤鸣知晓，这些弟子，将是此次参加大比的弟子。
一直到巳时，在中间那座五六丈高台之上，突然显露出了二十多人，其中百炼堂堂主张力当中而坐。

“下方诸位弟子听着，欲要参加此次比试的弟子，去到此石台之后领取号牌，今后比试，将以此好牌为准。”
就在台下众人相互议论之时，当初主持秦凤鸣等人入门测试的王长老现身在了高台之前。
制止住众人议论后，如是说道。
其声音并不很大，但是在场每个人都听得清清楚楚。
随着王长老话音，立即便弟子走出，轻车熟路的便自去到了石台之后。
秦凤鸣见此，自是不再迟疑，向段猛点头之后，也步出了众人之处。
一会儿功夫之后，在段猛众人的惊愕目光之中，秦凤鸣重新走回，其手中，此时已然握着一个写有号码的竹牌。
“凤鸣，此次比试，难道你也会参加不成？”
见到此处的段猛等同来弟子自是大惊。
“呵呵，不错，我向堂主哀求，才好不容让其答应让我一试。”
听闻此次比试，秦凤鸣竟然参加，众同来弟子登时均都面现不可思议之情。
他们可是被教习明确告知的，此次比试，本届弟子，均不得参加。
此时的秦凤鸣，自是不会详加说明什么。
content_en:
After getting the master's affirmative agreement, Qin Fengming practiced martial arts even harder, leaving early and returning late, rain or shine, without any interruption.
After Hall Master Zhang came back, he did not see Yuan Kejian, so he was very puzzled. Although he asked other disciples, he did not delve too deeply into the matter, because the selection of new disciples in Luoxia Valley was also in full swing at this time.
At this time, he had no time to deal with the disappearance of one or two recent disciples.
The sun and the moon shuttled back and forth, flowers bloomed and fell, and months passed without realizing it.
The day for the martial arts competition in Bailiantang was getting closer and closer. During this period, other disciples who started with Qin Fengming also learned about the martial arts competition from their own teachers. While everyone was excited, they were told that they were not allowed to participate in this year's competition, but could only go and watch. This made the disciples feel extremely discouraged.
But after thinking about it, everyone felt relieved. They had calculated everything. They had only been in Luoxia Valley for three years, and they had only been practicing martial arts for two years. Compared with the disciples who had been practicing for six or seven years, one can imagine the gap between them.
In this competition, all previous disciples who are still practicing in Bailian Hall will participate. The total number of people is sixty or seventy. The person with the least entry has been five or six years old, and among them there are more than ten people who have been in the industry for ** years.
Fortunately, this kind of competition is limited to Bailian Hall. If we include the children of Luoxia Valley disciples, there will be hundreds of people of the same age.
One can imagine how difficult it is to achieve good results in a competition with so many experts participating.
Although Qin Fengming didn't pay much attention to the results of the competition, he certainly had a competitive spirit at a young age.
Therefore, apart from practicing martial arts every day, Qin Fengming no longer paid attention to anything else.
As the days passed, finally, the day of the competition finally arrived.
In the early morning of this day, a young man wearing a green shirt took Qin Fengming and other disciples to a valley.
This valley is very vast. In the valley, there are ten stone platforms that are two to three feet high. Each platform is more than twenty feet wide and narrow.
There is a high platform in the middle, but it is five or six feet high.
Looking down at the surroundings from this high platform, the surrounding high platforms are clearly visible.
At this time, there were already many disciples in the valley, with waves from the east and west gathering together.
Surrounded by young men wearing green shirts and brown gowns, Qin Fengming had never seen these people before, and they were not Bailiantang disciples.
Looking at the disciples wearing gray shirts gathered together in the middle of the valley, Qin Fengming knew that these disciples would be the ones participating in the competition.
Until 4 o'clock, on the five or six foot high platform in the middle, more than twenty people suddenly appeared, among whom Bailian was sitting in the center.
"Listen, disciples below. Those who want to participate in this competition should go to this stone platform to get their number plates. In future competitions, this good card will be used as the criterion."
While everyone in the audience was talking among themselves, Elder Wang, who had presided over the entry test for Qin Fengming and others, appeared in front of the high platform.
After stopping everyone's discussion, he said this.
The sound was not very loud, but everyone present could hear it clearly.
Following Elder Wang's words, the disciples immediately walked out and arrived behind the stone platform.
Seeing this, Qin Fengming no longer hesitated. After nodding fiercely to Duan, he also walked out of the crowd.
After a while, under the astonished gazes of Duan Meng's crowd, Qin Fengming walked back again, already holding a bamboo sign with a number in his hand.
"Feng Ming, can't you participate in this competition?"
Seeing Duan Meng and other disciples here, they were naturally shocked.
"Haha, that's right. I begged the hall master and finally got him to agree to let me give it a try."
Upon hearing that Qin Fengming actually participated in this competition, all the disciples who came with him felt incredulous.
They were clearly informed by their instructors that in this competition, this year's disciples,are not allowed to participate.
At this time, Qin Fengming would not explain anything in detail.
